patch --no-backup-if-mismatch -p1 <<'PATCH'
--- /dev/null
+++ b/build/field-defaults-check/Foo.java
@@ -0,0 +1,13 @@
+public record Foo() {}
+record WithComponent(String value) {}
+record WithNested(int value) {
+	static class Nested {
+		int value = 0;
+	}
+}
+class Ordinary {
+	int value = 0;
+}
+interface Sample { int CONSTANT = 1; }
+@interface Marker {}
+enum Choice { ONE; int value = 0; }
--- /dev/null
+++ b/build/field-defaults-check/Annotated.java
@@ -0,0 +1,2 @@
+@lombok.experimental.FieldDefaults(makeFinal = true)
+public record Annotated() {}
--- /dev/null
+++ b/build/field-defaults-check/private/lombok.config
@@ -0,0 +1,3 @@
+config.stopBubbling = true
+lombok.fieldDefaults.defaultPrivate = true
+lombok.fieldDefaults.defaultFinal = false
--- /dev/null
+++ b/build/field-defaults-check/final/lombok.config
@@ -0,0 +1,3 @@
+config.stopBubbling = true
+lombok.fieldDefaults.defaultPrivate = false
+lombok.fieldDefaults.defaultFinal = true
--- /dev/null
+++ b/build/field-defaults-check/both/lombok.config
@@ -0,0 +1,3 @@
+config.stopBubbling = true
+lombok.fieldDefaults.defaultPrivate = true
+lombok.fieldDefaults.defaultFinal = true
PATCH
set -e
for variant in private final both; do
  dir="/testbed/build/field-defaults-check/$variant"
  cp build/field-defaults-check/Foo.java build/field-defaults-check/Annotated.java "$dir/"
  javac -cp /testbed/dist/lombok.jar -d "$dir/classes" "$dir/Foo.java"
  case "$variant" in
    private) expected='private int value;' ;;
    final) expected='final int value;' ;;
    both) expected='private final int value;' ;;
  esac
  javap -p -classpath "$dir/classes" Ordinary 'WithNested$Nested' Choice | grep -F "$expected"
  javap -p -classpath "$dir/classes" WithComponent | grep -F 'private final java.lang.String value;'
  if javac -cp /testbed/dist/lombok.jar -d "$dir/classes" "$dir/Annotated.java" > "$dir/explicit.log" 2>&1; then
    echo 'ERROR: Explicit @FieldDefaults on a record was accepted'; exit 1
  fi
  grep -F '@FieldDefaults is only supported on a class or an enum.' "$dir/explicit.log"
  echo "$variant: record compilation and explicit-annotation rejection verified"
done

done

rm /testbed/build/field-defaults-baseline.log /testbed/build/field-defaults-regression-before.log /testbed/build/field-defaults-after.log /testbed/build/field-defaults-dist.log /testbed/build/field-defaults-eclipse.log
